entries.subject: ESA/Webb elgordo1
entries.finding: Webb spotlights gravitational arcs in 'El Gordo' galaxy cluster (NIRCam image): Webb NIRCam, six filters from 1.15 to 4.4 µm, the shortest wavelengths blue and the longest red; 4422 × 4421 px over 2.21 arcmin, CC BY 4.0. The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.03001 arcsec per pixel, north 5.2° right of vertical, the frame's centre at 15.7306709°, -49.2603915°. Not measured against Gaia here; the same publishers' tags were within 0.4 arcsec on four cluster pictures and 1.5 arcsec off on one deep field.
